title: A Journal protocol so the S3 document adapters accept any compare-and-swap journal
description:
Eight isinstance checks across the S3 adapters require the concrete S3Journal (S3EmbeddedStorage, S3RuntimeStores, S3ReviewStorage, S3EvaluationStorage, S3BatchStorage, S3ConsoleStorage, S3OptimizerTransport), and S3Journal requires S3Payloads (src/decision_flywheel/s3_journal.py:40). The document adapters are store-agnostic dict logic over a journal with initialize, read and commit, so a file, GCS or Azure journal would reuse every adapter unchanged, and specs could run without the fake S3 client. A FilePayloads already exists (storage_payloads.py:60) with no file journal to use it.
Do: define a Journal Protocol (initialize, read, commit, the exception types) in a journal module, check adapters against it, add a LocalFileJournal over FilePayloads for tests and single-machine use, and cache the immutable anchor per handle so read() is not three GETs and commit() does not re-read it (s3_journal.py:127, :151); expose a public exists() so s3_sessions.py:103 stops reaching into journal._get.
Done when: no adapter imports S3Journal for a type check, the adapter specs run against both the S3 fake and the file journal, GET count per read drops to two or fewer. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
